## 1.8.0-dev.1 (2026-11-25)

- **LinkedIn:** Add 4.1.1278 (build 218600) support, prevent Hide games from hiding rows on the More screen, switch Expand posts to ExpandableTextState.<init>, move BadFella Patches to a bottom-left Material pill in the Me panel, split Feed filters into its own category, and add On/Off/Not applied filters to Patch status.
